purpose: Characterize the entire existing specified-receiver parameter family, preserving unfavorable/no-gain outcomes rather than selecting another illustrative case
inputs: Unchanged R30_PRODUCER_FAMILY_RESULTS.json, its prospective domain/proof, and unchanged profile/canonical/projection code. No new execution/native acquisition.
parameter_domain: All p1..12, q1..3p, s0=0..p-1:1950 parameter entries; reject all328 entries with any reachable poll/receipt tie; analyze all1622 admitted entries including duplicate/equivalent phases and nonempty transients. These are parameter entries in one source/receiver family, not independent applications.
scope_of_queries: Use each recurrent cycle only, after its transient. J and A are tight maxima on that same cycle; completion enclosure uses exactly its actual c values. Positive recurrent observer queries do not by themselves prove safe execution of a prefix or installation. Prefix size/entry counts remain reported.
storage_rule: For every admitted case use g=d/gcd(d,3), with d its recurrent translation. This fixed rule was chosen after the earlier g27/d81 and g140/d420 examples; it is not an optimal/adaptive per-case choice or a pre-observation deployment policy. If3 does not divide d, keep the full master. Unsupported query modulus m=gcd(P,d) is always reported; answer only from master/producer.
primary_grid: Repeat the original R30 scalar grid exactly: P1..2p, all phi0..P-1, K1/2. Its known full-master totals643060 queries/12168 positive/630892 nonpositive serve only a consistency check. New support/size/completion-rescue distributions are unknown before this computation.
expanded_grid: Also declare P1..4p, all phi0..P-1, K1..5. This includes the loads and periods of both R34 twelve-phase illustrations and is chosen after seeing them. Report both grids without selecting a favorable one. Grids are finite deterministic sensitivity domains, not empirical query-frequency samples or expected workload utility.
denominators: Raw/master/stored/completion-stored sizes count parameter entries; query payload sizes count parameter-entry/physical-P interfaces once, separately from phase/load-weighted policy-query counts. Report supported/unsupported interfaces and policy queries; supported positive/unknown and unsupported are disjoint. Within all/supported positives count Delta>0 and fair D<=0 rescues, retaining all both-positive and neither-positive outcomes.
checks: Validate raw/master/stored/query payload envelopes using independent explicit recurrent expansion for each P/phi. Compare fair completion canonical profile with direct completion-event expansion. Require D<=Delta and the joint-witness iff for every interface. Reproduce the primary known totals. Retain per-entry summaries, all size histograms, no-reduction cases, no-rescue cases, regime counts and every rejected parameter entry.
additional_clarifications: Recompute R34 three disjoint storage outcomes. Document existing source-control invariant, explicit zero-byte validity-only composition alphabet, actual admission-control scope and claim-level novelty map using prior code/arguments. No claims beyond executed checks.
scope: New local analysis of existing conditional recurrent relations. Not native HUSH, arbitrary programs/data coherence, physical conformance, deployment, measured time/bytes or application gain. Minimal own protocol/analysis/aggregates can be published under standing authorization. Manuscripts/private overlays/acquisition/server materials remain excluded.
